<thought>The spectrum shows a monoisotopic peak at 127.10 with a clear M+1 (≈8 % of base) and much smaller M+2, M+3, etc., matching the characteristic 13C isotopic envelope for a molecule containing several carbons. No 2 Da spaced doublet (Cl, Br) or the distinct sulfur pattern is observed, and other elements have isotopic abundances too low to be seen. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
